title: Ask AI Golden Question Set
description: Regression test fixture for stevenjhu.com Ask AI (RAG). Each question includes expected intent, source folders/paths, and answer requirements. Use to verify retrieval accuracy, refusal behavior, and citation correctness.

questions.question: 這個網站的作者是誰？
questions.notes: Should return author name and basic identity from about/profile.md

questions.question: 作者是男的還是女的？
questions.notes: Should confirm male, handle typo '難的'. Can mention '魔羯男' from profile.

questions.question: 作者專長是什麼？
questions.notes: Should mention software engineer, NOT AI/ML researcher. Primary skills: C#/.NET, frontend, backend, DB, PM, business.

questions.question: 怎麼聯絡作者？
questions.notes: Should include GitHub (steven5j), Facebook, CakeResume links from about/

questions.question: 有哪些作品或證照可以看？
questions.notes: Should direct to /projects, list major works and certs from faq/projects.md or projects/index.md

questions.question: 送報件系統升級專案做了什麼？
questions.notes: CRITICAL: Must NOT confuse with report-data-fix. This is the big system rewrite (Cobol → C#).

questions.question: 送報件資料修正輔助系統做了什麼？
questions.notes: CRITICAL: Must NOT confuse with report-system-upgrade. This is the data fix helper tool.

questions.question: 送報件專案有哪些？
questions.notes: Should distinguish both projects clearly: upgrade (Cobol→C#) vs data-fix tool.

questions.question: Vitawile 專案做了什麼？
questions.notes: Should return Vitawile project details from projects/vitawile.md

questions.question: 租管網站專案做了什麼？
questions.notes: Should return rental management project details

questions.question: 發信 API 專案做了什麼？
questions.notes: Should return email API project details

questions.question: AZ-104 證照是什麼？
questions.notes: Should return AZ-104 cert details from projects/azure-az-104.md

questions.question: AWS SAA 證照考了哪些內容？
questions.notes: Should return AWS SAA cert details

questions.question: 有哪些系列文章？
questions.notes: Should list series or direct to /series page. May pull from catalog/series.md.

questions.question: C# 系列有哪些文章？
questions.notes: Should scope to series/ and blog/. May mention series/csharp.md and related blog posts.

questions.question: 房地產系列有哪些內容？
questions.notes: Should return real-estate series details

questions.question: 依賴注入那篇文章寫了什麼？
questions.notes: Should retrieve blog/c-netdi-依賴注入dependency-injection-與注入方式.md or similar

questions.question: 作者寫過哪些技術文章？
questions.notes: Should direct to /blog or list from catalog/blog.md

questions.question: 明天天氣如何？
questions.notes: Should refuse and suggest site entry points (/blog, /projects, /series, /about)

questions.question: 作者做過 LINE Bot 專案嗎？
questions.expectedIntent: unknown project query (should refuse or check)
questions.notes: Should either refuse (not found) or check projects/ carefully. Do NOT invent projects.

questions.question: 作者在 Google 工作過嗎？
questions.notes: Should NOT fabricate work history. Only mention what's in about/profile.md.

questions.question: 送報件系統升級專案中作者擔任什麼角色？
variants: 送報件系統改版的角色
questions.notes: Role: 工程師、小組長. Should not mix with report-data-fix project.

questions.question: 送報件資料修正專案中作者的角色是什麼？
variants: 資料修正輔助系統 role
questions.notes: Role: 規劃者、小組長. Should not mix with report-system-upgrade.

questions.question: 那這個專案用了什麼技術？
questions.notes: Requires previous turn context (conversation messages). Should refer to last-mentioned project.

questions.question: 作者是難的還是女的？
questions.notes: System prompt says to handle typo '難的' as '男的'. Should answer correctly.

questions.question: 作者的職業是什麼？
questions.notes: Should return software engineer role, not AI/ML researcher.

questions.question: 在哪裡可以看到作者的作品？
questions.notes: Should use Markdown link format [作品](/projects), not bare 'URL: /projects' appendix.

questions.question: Astro 重構專案做了什麼？
questions.notes: Should return Astro rebuild project details from projects/blog-astro-rebuild.md

questions.question: 2022 年目標檢討文章寫了什麼？
questions.notes: 2022年目標完成狀況與相關自我檢討🔒密碼保護.md is protected. Should say it's locked and can't reveal content.

questions.question: 職涯系列有哪些內容？
questions.notes: Should return career series details from series/career.md

questions.expectedIntent: empty query (should reject at API level)
questions.notes: API should return error 'query or messages is required.' Empty query should be rejected before RAG.

usage: To test: iterate through questions, call POST /api/ask with { query }, verify answer sources match expectedSources and answer text includes mustInclude / excludes mustNotInclude. Check that citations are clickable and link format is correct. Ensure low-relevance questions trigger refusal with site entry point suggestions.
